description: dip.rest is a read-only guide to editorially reviewed restaurants, bars, collections, and published food articles in Georgia. It can search public place listings, return a public place card, browse editorial collections, and search or fetch published guides in Russian, English, and Georgian with source URLs. It does not book tables, message venues, change accounts, or access private user data.
